async def act(page):
    # First, try to locate a search bar on the current page
    search_bar = page.get_by_role("searchbox").or_(page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Search")).or_(page.get_by_placeholder("Search"))
    if await search_bar.count() > 0:
        await search_bar.first.fill("diabetes")
        # Try to submit the search, e.g., by pressing Enter or clicking a search button
        await search_bar.first.press("Enter")
        await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
        # After search, locate the bottom result and click it
        results = page.get_by_role("link").or_(page.get_by_role("button"))  # Adjust based on actual result elements
        if await results.count() > 0:
            await results.last.click()
            await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    else:
        # If no search bar found, click on 'Sample Page' to explore further
        await page.get_by_role("link", name="Sample Page").click()
        await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
